fullPassage: Consumer surveys indicate that the majority of Americans (91%) believe they have some control over their health, and 72% believe that food and nutrition play the greatest role. However, 75% of consumers rely on media outlets including the Internet as their major sources of health and nutrition information, and only half use medical sources. A Google search for "nutrition listservs" yielded over 100,000 sites, but it is likely that many of these writings are not reviewed by nutrition experts. Internet sites marketing herbs, drugs, and health devices are not monitored by government regulatory agencies and often contain misleading information. Reputable food companies provide helpful facts about the nutrient content of their products, but commercial sites devoted to sales often post misleading health claims. Internet sites maintained by government agencies, universities, state extension services, and medical facilities provide evidence-based information and should be the first source for public information on foods, nutrition, and health.

✅ ③ the first source: 최우선 출처, 원문 일치 — 증거 기반 정보 제공 기관이므로
❌ ① the last resort: 최후의 수단, 반의어
❌ ② completely avoided: 완전히 피해야 할, 반의어
❌ ④ permanently banned: 영구적으로 금지된, 부적절
det.tip: the first source(최우선 출처) — 신뢰할 수 있는 기관의 정보가 우선되어야 한다

questions.passage: Consumer surveys indicate that the majority of Americans (91%) believe they have some control over their health, and 72% believe that food and nutrition play the greatest role. However, 75% of consumers rely on media outlets including the Internet as their major sources of health and nutrition information, and only half use medical sources. A Google search for "nutrition listservs" yielded over 100,000 sites, but it is likely that many of these writings are not reviewed by nutrition experts. Internet sites marketing herbs, drugs, and health devices are not monitored by government regulatory agencies and often contain misleading information. __________ provide helpful facts about the nutrient content of their products, but commercial sites devoted to sales often post misleading health claims.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 평판 좋은 식품 회사(Reputable food companies)가 제품의 영양 성분에 대해 도움이 되는 사실을 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② Reputable food companies: 원문 일치 — helpful facts를 제공하는 주체
❌ ① Unregulated online vendors: 규제 없는 온라인 판매자 — helpful과 모순
❌ ③ Anonymous blog writers: 익명 블로거 — helpful facts와 부적합
❌ ④ Individual health enthusiasts: 개인 건강 애호가 — nutrient content 전문성 부족
det.tip: Reputable food companies — 'helpful facts'와 'nutrient content'를 제공할 수 있는 주체
